description: Projets agro-environnementaux et climatiques (PAEC) Seine-Maritime et Eure - Normandie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.normandie.fr. The various 2020 projects in the former Haute-Normandie (HN) CEAP submitted by project leaders as part of the Agricultural, Environmental and Climate Measures - DFAIT. The data does not fall within the scope of the Inspire Directive. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include environnement, agriculture, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2022-01-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
